## About Valtix Business Solutions
Valtix Business Solutions is a premier virtual accounting, corporate tax compliance, and bespoke digital software engineering consultancy based in Dubai, UAE. We serve UAE mainland enterprises, Free Zone businesses, and regional SMEs with audit-ready bookkeeping, VAT returns, EmaraTax Corporate Tax filings, WPS payroll, and modern cloud web development.

- Official Phone: +971 52 883 4899
- Contact Email: info@valtixsolutions.com
- Primary Service Territory: UAE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, JAFZA, DAFZA, DMCC, DIFC, ADGM)

## Core Public Services

### 1. UAE Virtual Accounting & Bookkeeping
- URL: https://valtixsolutions.com/#services
- Description: Audit-ready monthly ledger maintenance, bank reconciliation, TRN tracking, and profit & loss statements on Zoho Books, QuickBooks Online, and Xero.

- URL: https://valtixsolutions.com/#services
- Description: Federal Tax Authority (FTA) 9% Corporate Tax registration, EmaraTax return preparation, Small Business Relief (SBR) advisory, and quarterly VAT-201 declarations.

- URL: https://valtixsolutions.com/services/custom-erp-development

### 6. Mobile Application Development
